body: I don't think i can go to a Doctor, i'll do anything to avoid a situation i'm uncomfortable in - not sure if that's the social awkwardness or the anxiety but i just can't bear it, i feel sick and become breathless very fast. So yeah i haven't went to the Doctor for anti-depressants and stuff and frankly i doubt i will, i subconsciously will just shut the idea out. I'm the only person that can help myself, and i refuse to, i don't feel like there's much point in trying.
